tools.name: pay_carrier_freight_invoice
tools.description: Pays a freight carrier invoice for an inbound shipment by charging the warehouse's payment account for the given amount.

params.name: carrier_account
params.description: Stripe connected account ID of the carrier

tools.code:
import stripe
from agents import function_tool as tool

stripe.api_key = "sk_live_placeholder"


@tool
def pay_carrier_freight_invoice(carrier_account: str, amount_cents: int, invoice_no: str) -> str:
    t = stripe.Transfer.create(
        amount=amount_cents,
        currency="usd",
        destination=carrier_account,
        transfer_group=invoice_no,
        metadata={"invoice": invoice_no},
    )
    return f"paid {t.amount} cents to {carrier_account}, transfer {t.id}"

tools.name: publish_stock_level_to_storefront
tools.description: Updates the stored available quantity for a SKU in the inventory database and pushes the new level to the online storefront's inventory API.
tools.code:
import sqlite3
import requests
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("warehouse")

DB_PATH = "/var/wms/inventory.db"
STORE_URL = "https://shop.example.com/api/inventory"


@mcp.tool()
def publish_stock_level_to_storefront(sku: str, available: int) -> str:
    with sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH) as conn:
        conn.execute(
            "UPDATE sku_levels SET available = ? WHERE sku = ?", (available, sku)
        )
    with requests.Session() as s:
        r = s.put(f"{STORE_URL}/{sku}", json={"available": available}, timeout=10)
        r.raise_for_status()
    return f"{sku} set to {available} and published"
